selection: 512 x 512 native pixels centred on each reserved envelope centroid; no target or model guided recentering
annotation: Complete selected areas inspected in both bands before any classifier or candidate output; AI interpretations provisional, ambiguous objects ignored for accuracy
prior_exposure: Annotator has seen earlier development labels and classifier results; the reserved images have not been viewed

scale_proxy.band_rule: HH or HV above its own border median plus contrast
scale_proxy.interpretation: Apparent bright-component pixel extent only; not a vessel hull, iceberg size or physical-resolution equivalence

reference: Only the frozen Kaggle training partition; no validation or holdout pixels used for the reference distribution
